provenance.runEncoding: Comma-separated immutable run-id:status pairs, ordered by started_at. Matrix IDs join the complete stored transcripts, tool results, original deterministic assertions, judge findings, scenario hashes and timing.
provenance.costMeaning: Recorded run cost from persistSingleRun's summary.totalCostUsd. This is not independently reconciled account billing; same-model pilot and judge-only replay costs are outside these cohorts.

findings.observation: Judge called plans:set-plan-status unavailable despite an intact successful tools:find receipt. Static registry omitted discovered tools.
findings.verification: New runner-to-judge regression failed before repair; all8 tests pass in ledger19692019. Canonical replay of unchanged subject transcript with same terra judge after repair passed with zero errors/warnings. Original row preserved.
findings.scope: Judge replay repairs assessment only; it is not a new subject run.

findings.observation: Both v12 and v13 report matrices had2passed/1failed; failing subjects produced prose without the required owner-report delivery effect.
findings.fixtureRepair: v12 exposed AUTO but did not bind its identity layer. Ten cross-contract tests failed in ledger19692993. v13 adds targetConfig.modes=['auto']; current unit/render suites pass53 tests in ledgers19693198/19693199.
findings.remaining: Mode omission alone is not a sufficient cause. Production reporting counts escalation/attention/to-human coord rails, not ordinary final prose. Resolve whether per-case GOAL versus engineer role binding is realistic before any further model or persona repair.

findings.observation: Independent advisory judge found an unsupported claim of live fleet leader ownership from placement-only receipt. Deterministic passed status does not erase the advisory finding.

limitations: These are isolated model opportunities using production agenda providers and explicit fixture effects; they do not prove live-workspace effects or matched causal improvement.
Versions12 and13 must not be combined into a current acceptance cohort. v12 lacks AUTO layer binding; only the version13 rows contain that repair.
The SU rubric makes judge findings advisory. A passed stored status does not mean zero judge errors or warnings; inspect the original judge_json.
Current version13 has no completed continue/delegate/verify/wait/unknown matrix in this artifact. Its report matrix failed once.
No full R-16 acceptance, independent plan acceptance, deployment containment, or shipment is asserted.
